claims.notice: Highlighted 1 passage for this statement on the page.
passages: A very recent start time is a warning sign. If you run systemctl status vastai repeatedly and the "ago" value keeps resetting to a few seconds or minutes (and the Main PID keeps changing), the service is crashing and being restarted over and over — a restart loop. The state activating (auto-restart) with a message like Restart=on-failure or Scheduled restart job also indicates a restart loop. In that case, inspect the logs (see the debugging commands below) to find the crash reason.
ranges: A very recent start time is a warning sign. If you run systemctl status vastai repeatedly and the “ago” value keeps resetting to a few seconds or minutes (and the Main PID keeps changing), the service is crashing and being restarted over and over — a restart loop. The state activating (auto-restart) with a message like Restart=on-failure or Scheduled restart job also indicates a restart loop. In that case, inspect the logs (see the debugging commands below) to find the crash reason.
